title: CreateOutcome.Created count returns eligible-slot count, not actual inserts — contradicts its own doc
detail: Doc claims count is rows actually inserted (0 on double-trigger). Impl returns list.length(eligible) — same on every trigger. double_trigger test asserts second trigger yields Created(count: 2) even though 0 rows inserted. Pub type contract is broken.
recommended_fix: Have create_one_slot return whether it actually inserted, sum those in create_eligible_slots, return that count. Or rewrite the doc to say 'number of eligible slots considered' and drop the '0 when already had a live row' clause.

title: Spec-mandated unit test file server/test/reference_checks/trigger_test.gleam absent from diff
evidence: - [ ] `server/test/reference_checks/trigger_test.gleam` — unit tests: slot selection (rented vs never-rented), no-contact skip, declined suppression, pre-v1 allowed, double-trigger idempotency, pre-excluded-slot respected, audit-on-create, declined-manual-start suppression
detail: The story's own task list mandates this unit test file. The diff adds only server/test/integration/reference_checks_trigger_integration_test.gleam. Integration tests cover the same ground, but the spec-mandated unit file is missing entirely.
recommended_fix: Add server/test/reference_checks/trigger_test.gleam with the listed unit cases, or amend the spec to delegate these scenarios to the integration suite and drop the task.

title: Spec-mandated test_db.gleam truncate-list extension for reference_call not present in diff
evidence: - [ ] `server/test/integration/reference_checks_trigger_integration_test.gleam` — DB-level ACs: real viewed PATCH creates the right rows; manual start on a non-viewed app; skip queued→skipped + create-skipped + idempotent; re-enable skipped→queued + next_attempt_at re-arm; declined suppression end-to-end; extend `test_db.gleam` truncate list for `reference_call`
detail: Integration-test task explicitly says to extend test_db.gleam's truncate list for reference_call. The diff adds the integration test file but contains no test_db.gleam modification. May already exist from RC2.1; not verifiable from the diff alone.
recommended_fix: Confirm test_db.gleam already truncates reference_call (likely added in RC2.1 when the table landed). If not, add it or integration tests will leak rows between cases and flake.

title: 'Skip a non-queued live row -> 409' spec I/O matrix scenario has no test
detail: The 409 arm for a mid-flight (non-queued, non-skipped) live row is implemented but undefended. Integration suite covers queued->skipped, before-trigger create, and idempotent skip, but never puts a row into contact_initiated to exercise this branch.
recommended_fix: Add an integration test that forces a row into contact_initiated (or another non-queued live status) and asserts do_skip returns 409 with the branded message.
